paper.extract.reason: Repeated full-source claim extraction and normalization; retain exact quotations and unresolved scope.

paper.extract_local.reason: Claim-batch extraction from local context only (v0.4 S6); premises may be cited only by ids supplied in the prompt.

paper.extract_focus.reason: Whole-paper context as one cache-stable prefix, one focus span per call (v0.4 S6); premises are occurrences of the same paper.

dependency.match.reason: Compare citation-localized semantic content, assumptions and mathematical support; a citation alone is not support.

dependency.match_retrieved.reason: Match one request pool against deterministically retrieved upstream claim readings (v0.4 S7); a citation alone is not support.

leg.judge.reason: Blinded check of one proposed premise against the conclusion's proof or statement (v0.4 AUTO_EVAL_V1); a USED verdict needs a bound quotation.

match.judge.reason: Blinded check that an upstream statement is the premise a citing region invokes (v0.4 AUTO_EVAL_V1); a USED verdict needs a bound quotation.

corpus.discover.reason: Propose arXiv ids of same-field papers for a DISCOVERY round (v0.4 §6.3); the host examines every proposal and admits none by itself.

autoformalization.failure_classify.reason: Classify an already recorded failure; cannot certify or rewrite proofs.

autoformalization.lean.reason: Construct Lean statements and proof terms with structured Lamport reasoning.

autoformalization.lamport.reason: Construct structured mathematical proofs for formalization.

autoformalization.premise.reason: Construct Lean premise proof terms; this is proof generation, not citation classification.

note: operation-routing-v2 (schema v0.4 §5.4). Frozen per new plan. A profile may state training_cutoff {value: YYYY[-MM[-DD]] | UNKNOWN, source}; absent, the route records UNKNOWN. No ambient default model or automatic expensive escalation.
